# Split

Splits text into an array of parts at each occurrence of a separator.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Split(text, separator)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to split. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `separator` | string | The text that separates the parts, matched exactly, case included. An empty separator, or null, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. An array of the strings between the separators, in order. Separators next to each other, or at the start or the end of text, give empty strings, so the array has one more element than there are separators; text with no separator gives an array of text alone. Never null.

## Example

`Split("a,b,,c", ",")` returns `["a", "b", "", "c"]`.
